info.title: Rehabify Partner API
info.summary: Refer patients to Rehabify Health, follow their care, and reconcile commissions.
info.description:
The Rehabify Partner API lets HMOs, hospitals and clinics, employers, gyms and digital health products refer patients to MRTBN-licensed physiotherapists, follow each referral's status, sessions and progress reports, manage no-code referral links, and reconcile commissions.

**Environments.** Sandbox and live share one base URL; the API key decides the environment (`sk_test_…` = sandbox, `sk_live_…` = live). The same API is also reachable at `https://physioaroundme.com/api/v1`.

**Conventions.** JSON (UTF-8) bodies; ISO-8601 UTC timestamps; money as integer kobo in fields ending `_kobo` with `currency` `NGN`; cursor pagination (`limit` 1–100, default 25, and `cursor`); `Idempotency-Key` on authenticated POST requests (remembered for 24 hours per environment). Every response carries `X-Request-Id` and `X-Rehabify-Environment`. Unknown request fields are ignored.

**Rate limits.** Sandbox 10 requests/second; live 20 requests/second (enterprise contracts: 100/s).

Documentation: https://docs.physioaroundme.com

servers.description: Sandbox and live. The API key selects the environment.

post.description: Creates a referral with status `received`. In live, Rehabify's care team and Joy (WhatsApp assistant) then contact the patient; give the patient `links.whatsapp_intake_url` so they can start immediately. Status changes are pushed by webhooks. In sandbox, magic phone numbers simulate journeys (`+2348000000004` returns 422 `patient_ineligible`).

clinical.notes: L4-L5 disc bulge on MRI. No red flags.

201.description: Referral created. A replayed request (same Idempotency-Key and body) returns the original response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

409.description: `duplicate_partner_reference` (a referral with this partner_reference already exists in this environment; `error.existing` holds its `id` and `tracking_code`) or `idempotency_request_in_progress`.

error.message: A referral with partner_reference HMO-REF-2026-0091 already exists.

422.description: `validation_error` (`param` set), `consent_required`, `patient_ineligible` (sandbox scenario +2348000000004; no referral created) or `idempotency_key_reused`.

error.message: consent.granted must be true.
The patient is not eligible for referral (sandbox scenario).

get.description: Returns referrals in the API key's environment, newest first.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only referrals in this public status.

parameters.name: partner_reference
parameters.description: Only the referral with this partner_reference.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Only referrals created after this time.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Only referrals created before this time.

get.description: `{id}` is the referral `id`, its `tracking_code` (case-insensitive) or your `partner_reference` (URL-encoded). Returns 404 `referral_not_found` when nothing matches in this environment, including referrals that belong to another partner or the other environment.

Appointments for your referrals, newest first. Session notes are never returned. This endpoint has no cursor: `next_cursor` is always null; narrow the filters when `has_more` is true. In sandbox, sessions are simulated from the referral's sandbox status (`simulated: true`).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Start of the range, applied to `scheduled_start`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. End of the range, applied to `scheduled_start`.

get.description: A non-clinical progress report for the referral: provider, session counts and milestones. Never contains clinical notes. `{id}` is any referral identifier.

get.summary: Download a progress report as PDF
get.description: The same report as a PDF document, sent as an attachment. Requires the same API key (server-to-server download).

Approved physiotherapists who are accepting patients. Unknown values are null (never invented). Single page: no cursor; `next_cursor` is null and `has_more` is true when more providers match than `limit`.

post.description: Creates a no-code referral link (`https://physioaroundme.com/r/<public_code>`). All fields are optional. The link inherits the API key's environment.

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate a referral link
patch.description: An inactive (or expired) link shows an "unavailable" page, accepts no leads and does not attribute.

get.description: If no signed contract exists, `contract.is_default` is true and the platform default partner share applies (`revenue_share_percent` = platform partner percent, currently 10). In sandbox, `earnings` are always zero.

Commission ledger. Live only; sandbox returns an empty list. Commissions are earned only on verified paid bookings by patients attributed to you (API referral, referral link or WhatsApp referral code). Refunds reverse the commission (status `reversed`, or a negative adjustment if already paid out). Paid out monthly to your verified bank account.

post.description: COMING SOON. With a live key this returns 501 `feature_not_available`. With a sandbox key it returns a simulated preview: any `member_id` containing `EXPIRED` returns `eligible: false` with `reason: "policy_inactive"`.

501.description: `feature_not_available`: eligibility checks are not yet available in live.

error.message: Eligibility checks are not yet available in live.

post.description: Moves a sandbox referral to a new status and fires the same webhooks a real transition fires (`booked` also fires `referral.provider_matched` first if no provider is matched yet). Moving backwards or out of a terminal status returns 422 `invalid_status_transition`. Live keys receive 403 `sandbox_only`.

error.message: Cannot move a referral from completed to contacted.

post.description: Queues a test event to your configured SANDBOX webhook endpoint, signed with your SANDBOX secret, in the same format as real events. Allowed types: every event type plus `ping`. Without `referral_id`, a sample sandbox referral is used (`id` `ref_sample_000000000000000000000000`, `tracking_code` `RHB-1234567890`). Test events for referral types carry `data.previous_status: null`, `data.sequence: 0` and `data.test: true`. Returns 409 `webhook_endpoint_not_configured` if no sandbox endpoint is set. Live keys receive 403 `sandbox_only`.

409.description: `webhook_endpoint_not_configured`: no webhook endpoint is configured for this environment.

error.message: No webhook endpoint is configured for the sandbox environment.

post.summary: Submit a lead through a referral link
post.description: Public, unauthenticated and CORS-enabled. Rate limited per IP address (5 requests per 10 minutes). Creates a referral in the link's environment (fires `referral.created`). `patient.first_name` is required, `patient.phone` or `patient.email` is required, and `consent.granted` must be true. If the same phone was submitted for this partner in the last 24 hours, returns 200 with `duplicate: true` and `tracking_code: null`.

201.description: Lead accepted; a referral was created.

200.description: Duplicate: the same phone was submitted for this partner in the last 24 hours. No new referral is created.

410.description: `link_inactive`: the link is inactive or expired.

error.message: This referral link is no longer active.

429.description: `rate_limit_exceeded`: more than 5 requests in 10 minutes from this IP address.

post.description: A referral is created (API, referral-link lead, or portal). `data.previous_status` is null.

2XX.description: Acknowledge within 10 seconds. Any other outcome (non-2xx, redirect, timeout, connection error) is retried.

post.description: Patient reached / intake started (incl. patient messaged Joy with the tracking code).
A physiotherapist was assigned. Matching does not change the status, so `data.previous_status` equals the referral's current status.
First appointment confirmed (payment verified or care covered).
Not appropriate for Rehabify services (patient redirected to appropriate care; no clinical detail disclosed).
Test event from the portal or POST /sandbox/trigger-webhook.

bearerAuth.description: Secret API key: `Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…` (sandbox) or `Bearer sk_live_…` (live). Keys are server-side secrets; never use them in browsers or mobile apps.

apiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyHeader.description: Alternative to the Authorization header: `X-API-Key: sk_test_…` or `sk_live_…`.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page. Opaque.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique string (≤255 characters) that makes the request safe to retry. Remembered for 24 hours per environment. Same key + same body replays the original response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); same key + different body returns 422 `idempotency_key_reused`; same key while the first request is still processing returns 409 `idempotency_request_in_progress`.

WebhookSignature.name: X-Rehabify-Signature
WebhookSignature.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>` where v1 = hex(HMAC_SHA256(key = signing secret, message = "<t>.<raw request body>")). Verify with a constant-time compare and reject if |now − t| > 300 s.

WebhookEventId.name: X-Rehabify-Event-Id
WebhookEventId.description: The event `id` (`evt_…`), stable across retries. Deduplicate on it.

WebhookDeliveryAttempt.name: X-Rehabify-Delivery-Attempt
WebhookDeliveryAttempt.description: 1 for the first attempt, up to 9 for the last retry.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique request ID. Quote it to support.

X-Rehabify-Environment.description: The environment that handled the request.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: When the window resets, in Unix seconds.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present (`true`) when the response was replayed for a repeated Idempotency-Key.

BadRequest.description: `invalid_json` (body is not valid JSON) or `invalid_parameter` (a query parameter is invalid; `param` set).

error.message: Request body is not valid JSON.
limit must be an integer between 1 and 100.
No API key supplied. Send Authorization: Bearer <key>.
The API key is unknown or has been revoked.

Forbidden.description: `partner_inactive` (organisation not approved or suspended), `production_access_required` (live key used but production access is not approved) or, on /sandbox endpoints, `sandbox_only` (live key used).

error.message: Your organisation is not active.
Production access has not been approved for your organisation.
This endpoint is only available with a sandbox (sk_test_) key.

ReferralNotFound.description: `referral_not_found`: no referral with that id / tracking code / partner_reference in this environment.

error.message: No referral found with identifier RHB-0000000000.
Referral link not found.

IdempotencyInProgress.description: `idempotency_request_in_progress`: a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still processing.

TooManyRequests.description: `rate_limit_exceeded`. Wait `Retry-After` seconds, then retry with backoff.

InternalError.description: `internal_error`: unexpected error. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

error.message: An unexpected error occurred. It is safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
The service is temporarily unavailable. Retry with backoff.
patient.phone must be a valid phone number (E.164, e.g. +2348012345678).
This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.
A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed.
Too many requests. Retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.

ReferralStatus.description: received: Rehabify accepted the referral. contacted: the care team / Joy reached the patient (intake started). booked: first appointment confirmed. in_treatment: rehabilitation sessions under way. completed: care episode completed / discharged. not_suitable: not appropriate for Rehabify services. cancelled: referral or booking cancelled / refunded. closed: no further activity expected.

TrackingCode.description: `RHB-` followed by 10 digits (older referrals: `RHB-` followed by 5 digits). Case-insensitive.

Metadata.description: Up to 20 keys (≤40 characters) with string values (≤500 characters). Echoed back on the referral and in webhooks. Do not put personal or clinical data here.

ReferralPatient.description: Patient contact details as stored. Never included in webhooks.

ReferralClinical.description: Clinical summary. `clinical.notes` is write-only and never returned.

ReferralProvider.description: The matched physiotherapist. In sandbox: `{ "name": "Sandbox Physiotherapist", "license_number": "SANDBOX-0001" }`.

tracking_url.description: Public status page (status timeline only; no personal or clinical data).

whatsapp_intake_url.description: Opens WhatsApp with Joy, pre-filled with `START <tracking_code>`.

WebhookReferral.description: The Referral object WITHOUT the `patient` block. Patient personal data is never sent in webhooks.

partner_reference.description: Your own reference. Unique per partner per environment (409 duplicate_partner_reference).

notes.description: Write-only: stored for Rehabify clinicians, never returned by the API or webhooks.

consent.description: Required. `granted` must be `true` (the partner attests the patient agreed to be contacted by Rehabify); otherwise 422 consent_required.

Session.description: One appointment. Session notes are never returned.

next_cursor.description: Always null: this endpoint has no cursor.

Report.description: Non-clinical progress report. Never contains clinical notes.

pdf_url.description: PDF download; requires your API key.

Provider.description: A verified physiotherapist. Unknown values are null (never invented).

has_more.description: true when more providers match than `limit`.

next_cursor.description: Always null: this endpoint has no cursor.

clicks.description: Unique visitors, de-duplicated per visitor per 30 minutes, bots excluded.

ReferralLinkCreateRequest.description: All fields optional. The link inherits the API key's environment.

is_default.description: true when no signed contract exists and the platform default partner share applies (currently 10%).

EligibilityCheck.description: Simulated sandbox preview. Live returns 501 feature_not_available.

referral_id.description: Optional sandbox referral `id` or `tracking_code`. Without it, a sample sandbox referral is used.

patient.description: `first_name` is required, and at least one of `phone` or `email`.

param.description: Present only when a specific field is at fault.

existing.description: Only on duplicate_partner_reference: the referral that already exists.

previous_status.description: Status before this event; null for referral.created and for test events. For referral.provider_matched it equals the current status.

sequence.description: Increases by 1 for every event of the same referral. 0 for test events.

test.description: Present (true) only on test events sent from the portal or POST /sandbox/trigger-webhook.

WebhookEvent.description: Event envelope. The request body is exactly what is signed (X-Rehabify-Signature).
